messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: inference-queue-backlog-high for service=runtime-ingest (severity: high)
incident-bot: Alert details: queue_depth=12k, enqueue_rate=1.8k/s, processing_rate=900/s, avg-latency=420ms, autoscaler_status=backoff
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Page fired to rotation 'eng-oncall' — INCIDENT: PD-1768005432. Escalation policy: primary -> 5min -> escalation.
devon: acked. taking point.
kim: — adding context: noticed elevated enqueue after promo, looks like sustained +3x over baseline for 30m. most requests are short-gen paths.
devon: thanks. first quick check: is scaler creating nodes? seeing knodes=48, target=120 in scale-controller logs.
devon: running: ```kubectl get hpa -n runtime runtime-ingest --output=wide```
devon: hpa shows desired=120, current=48, last_scale_reason="api quota denied"
sre_lead: api quota denied -> cloud provider quota? which quota exactly?
prod_ops_bot: Cloud API error: COMPUTE_INSTANCES_QUOTA_EXCEEDED for project redwood-prod, region us-west1.
mira: oh. so autoscaler requests nodes but provider returned quota error. that explains stuck desired vs current.
devon: checking scale-controller logs: ```[scale-controller] 2026-03-14T21:45:12Z error: createInstances: quotaExceeded: quota limit CPU 2000 exceeded for region us-west1```
kim: confirm: quota for vCPUs in us-west1 is 2000, current usage is ~1989, request batch pushes over.
devon: quick mitigation options: 1) manual surge by reserving capacity (if available) 2) route new traffic to warmpool/dedicated cluster 3) open emergency quota increase with cloud provider (takes time)
sre_lead: do 1+2 in parallel. devon, mira coordinate manual capacity bump. kim open PD to cloud quota ops (I can follow through). I'll update status to execs in 10.
mira: starting manual provisioning from spare nodepool: `gcloud compute instances create-with-container ... --zone=us-west1-a --count=10` (will take ~3-5min).
devon: I'm flipping routing: mark runtime-ingest route to scale down new request distribution to multi-region fallback (us-east1 warmpool). adding route tag now.
prod_ops_bot: Update: routing rule applied: failover to us-east1 warmpool enabled for path /v1/infer (rate-limited to 500/s).
kim: cloud support ticket opened: TICKET-987653. requested immediate quota bump to 2300 vCPUs, selecting expedited review.
devon: manual nodes provisioning started. logs: ```ProvisionTask ID=pt-9921 status=creating
ProvisionTask ID=pt-9921 node=runtime-warm-02 zone=us-west1-b created
ProvisionTask ID=pt-9921 node=runtime-warm-03 created
ProvisionTask ID=pt-9921 node=runtime-warm-04 failed: IP_POOL_EXHAUSTED
ProvisionTask ID=pt-9921 node=runtime-warm-05 created
```
mira: hitting IP_POOL_EXHAUSTED on one AZ. starting cross-AZ create.
devon: good, we have +4 nodes up => knodes=52. still far from desired 120 but throughput improvement expected from routing.
kim: monitoring metrics: processing_rate increased to 1.3k/s after failover, latency dropped to 280ms, queue_depth down to 7.2k. good trend.
sre_lead: excellent. keep observing 10m, if queue continues draining we'll keep the route. if not, escalate to execs and consider emergency commercial quota.
devon: FYI logs show frequent 429 from model-serving: "kv-cache-miss-queue-backlog" — might need small config tweak to increase worker threads while we wait for nodes.
mira: pushing temporary worker bump: ```kubectl -n runtime scale deployment model-worker --replicas=80``` then adjust concurrency: ```env WORKER_THREADS=32```
prod_ops_bot: Deployment update applied. model-worker replicas=80 -> observed spike in CPU; autoscaler can't respond due to cloud quota but local pods scale across available nodes.
kim: cloud ticket updated: provider acknowledged receipt, expedited review requested, estimated time 30-90min.
devon: queue is draining slower than expected. current: queue_depth=5.4k, processing_rate=1.45k/s. still ~40min to stable if linear.
sre_lead: ok escalate PD to next oncall after 20min if not recovered. mira, set handoff plan.
mira: I'm scheduled to be primary until 00:00 UTC; devon will handoff at 23:15 local. I'll take next 30.
devon: handoff notes -> actions taken: routed to us-east warmpool, manual nodes created (+4), worker replicas bumped, cloud ticket TICKET-987653 opened. outstanding: request quota increase, replenish IP pool in us-west1 region, evaluate model-serving 429s for caching.
kim: also FYI: we saw unrelated spike in ephemeral storage ops — filed infra issue INFRA-342. not blocking but noisy.
prod_ops_bot: Customer impact summary (automated): ~7% of requests within 21:40-22:10 UTC experienced delays >1s, <0.5% errors returned 429. Affected customers: randomized subset of free-tier and some PLG users in us-west1.
sre_lead: draft to customers: short blurb acknowledging degraded performance, mitigation in progress, no data loss, follow-up to include root cause (provider quota) and timeline. mira please prepare a public status update once we have stable queue <1k.
mira: will draft status: "Experiencing degraded inference latency in us-west1 due to provider quota limits affecting autoscaling. We have enabled cross-region failover and manual capacity surge; service is recovering. No data loss. We'll update when backlog is cleared."
devon: PD escalations: currently primary acked. if PD escalates, next rotation: alex -> jordan. Paging window set to 20m.
kim: monitoring alert adjusted: suppress further PD pages for this alert group for 30m to avoid noise, keep internal metrics dashboards live.
sre_lead: good. once backlog <1k, close incident, schedule postmortem to cover quota management and warmpool sizing. Assign to devon/kim/mira. 72h follow-up.
mira: noted. adding investigative tickets: - infra/quotas fix, - warmpool sizing policy, - model-serving retry/backoff review.
devon: final status update: queue_depth=890, processing_rate=1.6k/s, avg-latency=210ms. continuing to monitor for 15m, then close.
prod_ops_bot: Incident PD-1768005432: status -> monitoring. Last update at 2026-03-14T22:02:10Z.
incident-bot: Reminder: create incident postmortem doc template when incident resolved. :memo:
mira: thanks everyone. handing off to oncall follow-through. I'll post the customer-facing status in ~10m. :white_check_mark:
